data: Incredible game with amazing story, relaxing gameplay and a satisfying ending, definitetly 10/10
I do recommend this game, it's a nice game, it has great music and I love the art style
My ONLY complaint is the price, otherwise highly recommend
It is so cozy and relaxing, and the soundtrack is amazing
My only complaint is it's too short
not worth the money do not recommend
It is too short and just not worth 20€
I really like the aesthetic of this game. It's short, I have already finished it two times but it's a relaxing game, I like replaying from time to time.

I am in LOVE with this game. I've been waiting for it since the earlier demos, and to see the full game and it's development since then is so, so good. The gameplay is relaxing (and the option for free placement in the accessibility options is really great for replayability), the story is gripping and made me cry, and I love the sticker achievement system and the GIF/video built-in tools. It feels complete as a game, and I am so excited to replay all the levels and use this game to decompress!

This is a short experience, but it's very cozy and satisfying. While I managed to purchase it for around $13, I probably wouldn't have paid too much more for it, simply due to it being so short. That said, the artwork is beautiful, and the narrative was charming.

Cute small game about moving places and above all moving forward in life. Playing Unpacking has been one of the most relaxing activities I've done in a long time. The soundtrack is great and especially the visuals are adorable. Surprisingly even a small game like this can have a storyline which unraveled over time. You have the creative freedom to decorate the space however you want which can be a bit challenging at times, given all the pieces of furniture have to be placed at the right spot.
I'd definitely recommend Unpacking to people who just want to relax and shut off their mind for a while!

Unpacking is such a cute game to play! It has a great story line, and you get to follow them throughout stages of life! Plus, there's some easter eggs references hidden throughout the game that are HIGHLY worth finding! If this game ever does a sequel, I'm down for it!

This is one of the most beautiful games I think I have ever played. Its sweet, cute, and has a lovely message in the stuffed animals, books, and other items you take out of those boxes. It leaves you thinking inward on your own life as you help the main character through the stages of their life. What a heartfelt and beautiful game.

Cute game with a decent story to follow along, I'm always a sucker for show-don't-tell story lines, but I will admit the game does need more content if it is to survive and keep a player base, which could be done easily if the developers decided to add different character story lines and rooms and houses we can explore, maybe in different country's!

Best advice if you're looking for the game is; watch content surrounding it before you do, and buy it when it's on sale, or ask for it as a gift. It isn't worth £15.49 (United Kingdom), even if you like this sort of stuff, it's a bit too overpriced.

You don't put toasters on top of the fridge ffs.

I'd also say to wait for a sale. $20 is a bit too much for a puzzle gane imo.

Neat puzzle game otherwise though, but damn is the final level long af.

So relaxing and fairly time consuming! Although the story is fairly short, it will 100% keep you entertained, relaxed and coming back for more. This is all achieved through chill music, lovely visuals and hidden clues as to whose life you're unpacking.

As someone who gets fairly anxious this game was lovely to calm down, wind down and relax too ( if only i could keep my bedroom as clean as i kept theirs tho lol) ^^
So satisfying, the controls are also so smooth and easy (placing, opening, turning, etc). Perfect cozy game!!!!
Charming, touching, relaxing game with delightful little details. Very rewarding to play all the way through and watch the story evolve.
A little and simple game, and very sweet. The story is in the details, which a satisfying "read" on the person you follow in the game.

I went into *Unpacking* thinking it would just be a nice, relaxing little game where you put things away, but it ended up being surprisingly nostalgic and emotional.

You follow the girl through different stages of her life, and you learn about her through all the little things she owns. I kept recognising things from my own childhood and thinking, “I had one of those!” 😂

Seeing her grow up, move house, change interests and eventually make a home of her own was honestly lovely. It brought back so many memories of growing up myself.

It's simple, cosy and incredibly satisfying to play. I really didn't expect a game about unpacking boxes to make me feel so nostalgic, but here we are. 😂📦❤️
A very relaxing game which is very satisfying especially if you like to organize your room!

Overall, I love the concept of this game. It's cute, it has great visual storytelling, and it's pretty unique!

Pros:
The art style and atmosphere is adorable and soothing.
The game is unique and each play-through will never look quite the same as the last.
The storytelling is great and even with no dialogue or even seeing the characters involved, you really become attached and end up with strong feelings about certain events.

Cons:
It only takes between 3-6 hours to complete a full play-through and there's only so much variety you can add.
It's overpriced at full price for only a handful of hours of game play, it's a good game, but wait for it to go on sale.

So, I love the game, but it needs more content to the story or more variety in general. Maybe add a few characters you can play through their lives as? Or add a mix of different items per level to make each play a fully unique experience.

Absolutely amazing at creative a moving narrative without text.

The early levels are wonderfully paced and enjoyable.

The last level is a bit of a drag though. There's only one mechanic in the game and by the end it gets repetitive. If it was made into two separate levels or there were less rooms it would have worked better.

This game is amazing and has very calming music in the background. I really do enjoy the play style with the pixels and the time line and subtle story line. I would recommend this game to many people.

The story and game-play is really short, which is such a bummer for a game that has so much potential. I got this as a gift, but even then the price seems a but unfair.

The game is beautiful, and has a lot of achievements that are hidden in the game if you don't find them in one run. I wish there was more story though.. Unless they update it in the future, I say get this game and play it on days you are bored.

I can't describe with words how much this game is pure art, a story of a girl growing up with a retro/pixely feel is amazing, and it all wraps up with a nice home, one you entirely unpacked yourself. In terms of do I recommend it? Of course I do, it's not something that you can play over and over, but it is something you will remember.
Scratched the organizing itch, super cute, lags when changing rooms but that might be my computer

Therapeutic game to play. I'd like to imagine myself in the mind of the character, tidying up certain areas of the house.

Some parts hit differently, especially when you're older. Sorting through the items remind me of the time me and my spouse bought our first home. We brought in a bunch of old items from our family homes, bought new items, and set about making the space our very own cosy home.

Some things are nostalgic relics from the past, some things are your hobbies or obsessions, and some things are just utiliarian but still needs its own space.

Wonderful game.
its adorable, I loved how you can see the storyline by the changes on the furniture and objects during the years. 10/10 made me tear up a bit at the end

I love it. It's perfect. I wish there were more stories and levels (DLCs?). But with a little bit of time passed, you can replay the story and it's just as satisfying and perfect. And every time I challenge myself to organize it a bit differently, so it's never exactly the same. I 100% recommend if you like calm satisfying sorting games. AND it's queer! And I really love that!

Super cute if you like organizing stuff or generally enjoy some repetitiveness for a few hours; however - that's the downside. You can play for as long as you'd like, but you're not getting very far with the money they price this game at. Every other
review for Unpacking says the same thing and they're all right. While I still recommend it, please get this if it's on sale or watch a playthrough of it instead.

Is a very nice game and nice idea but poorly executed. It was ALMOST one of my fav games.. BUT...

PRO:

Relaxing
Nice music
Nice graphic
New great concept

CONS:

Short, 5 hours
Don't like when the apartment has items already inside. I loved the first two level when it was empty. Then liking it less
Don't like when the apartment is messy and you can't tidy up
Don't like when there are too many items already in the house.

The cons remove all the pleasure for me and satisfaction.. maybe even stressing :)
Absolute perfection of an experience. Beautifully written and delivered, just so many details that brought me to years with scarcely a word being said. Emergent narrative at its best.
The game is very touching, cute, and fun. However, I would only recommending buying it on sale. $20 for 4 hours max, full achievements is a lot

Unpacking is an unexpectedly deep and touching game — all without a single word. At first glance, it’s a simple puzzle game about unpacking boxes after a move. But behind this calm process lies a quiet, intimate story of life, change, new beginnings, and loss.

The gameplay is meditative and soothing: you simply place objects on shelves, in drawers, and around different rooms. Yet over time, you begin to realize that every item tells a piece of someone’s story — full of emotion, memories, and subtle growth. The game speaks entirely through objects, and that’s incredibly powerful.

The visual style is minimalist yet cozy and expressive. The soundtrack is gentle and relaxing, enhancing the nostalgic, almost therapeutic atmosphere.

Pros:
✔ Emotional and atmospheric journey
✔ Unique storytelling through objects
✔ Lovely pixel art and calming music
✔ Soothing, almost therapeutic gameplay

Cons:
➖ Short (but feels complete)
➖ Limited replay value

Rating: 8.5/10 — A heartfelt, quiet game that brings back memories of moves, changes, and new chapters in life. Honest, gentle, and deeply human. Highly recommended for those seeking a soulful experience.

Loved this game enough to buy it on Steam after having played through it multiple times on GamePass. I love the way it story tells through the items and spaces. It's like snooping through someone's stuff. It's very short for 20 bucks.
It's a nice cozy game that doesn't take to long to play through. It's fun to get lost in a little while and the achievements - some of which are quite funny - are a nice touch :) Would recommend!
As someone who loves to organize this is a great sim to resemble that. This is a great puzzle game and is a great game to play when need to relax. Highly recommended.

Really chill game, you learn a lot about who the person youre unpacking their stuff is and what is going on at each milestone in their life. I would recommend this game ONLY when its on sale. $20 for a game that has no replayability or updates to add more rooms and focus on perhaps other people's story is not worth it for the few hours that you play it.

Would love if we got updates for this in the future focusing on a different set of characters.

I never thought the idea of unpacking items and placing them neatly in the appropriate nooks and crannies could be so enjoyable, yet here I am.
It's almost as fun as unpacking boxes after a fresh move in real-life, except not as exciting or stressful.
This is definitely a game for the more OCD kind of person.
Good times. :)
It is very calm and relaxing, and is also kind of a puzzle game, trying to find the right place to put stuff somewhere can be tricky, but overall it is fun.

Very cute and cozy little game. I'm a sensitive person and it pulled on my heart strings a bit, might've teared up a time or two lol. But if you enjoy just chilling out and organizing I think you'd really enjoy the game!

This is such a cozy, relaxing game. I really enjoy the story telling in this game - you aren't told anything definitively and can completely ignore it if you want, but there's just so many little details that make this game feel like you're actually unpacking a real person's belongings. I love that the game follows the same person. I can't wait to finish all of the rooms and replay it to find new ways to arrange the spaces.

If you like decorating games I think you'll love this game.
This game is one of my favorites. It lets me organize vicariously when I feel like organization is too much. Love it.
Cute game that makes unpacking look easier and funnier than it really is. lol. Just wish the game was longer.

I loved the game play and the art style was amazing. I got the game on sale for 13.67 CAD and i finished the game in 4.3h. Despite how cute and fun the game is, its not worth paying full price for. Its just too short. I was very shocked reaching the end, i was expecting a few more lives to follow.

My new favorite game EVER. The only downside is the price. If this game was $15, I would say that's very fair and give it a perfect glowing review, but $20 seems just a little steep for the amount of content you're getting. Minor complaint, though. I love placing things and tidying and making things neat and all that. If you enjoy that too, GET THIS GAME. You'll probably love it. I love visual ASMR.

Good game, unfortunately it's very short... I finished in 3.8 hours, and when it finished i was taken by surprise, to me this could have been at least half the game, with half more to go. Still worth it, to be honest. I loved some details about the main character (personal objects), you guys made me happy. And the chicken and chicks? OMG lovely. Also the last scene. Because of how short it is, i WILL recommending buying it on sale like I did.

I loved this game! Probably my favorite of the organizing/decorating games I've played. The environmental storytelling was a nice touch. It only has around 5-6 hours of gameplay so I'd recommend getting on sale. I would love it if the devs made DLC or a sequel to the game with different environments.
it's an incredibly cute game! it takes you just about 3 hours if you take your time- unless you get this on mega sale i wouldn't splurge!

absolutely love this game!! i adore following some form of plot while keeping it an adorable game about unpacking - i'm come back to play it so many times when really stressed and will continue to do so:) wish there were more levels!

Utterly, utterly delightful.
Understated, calm, and fun. Just a BIT too long to recommend playing in one setting - try breaking it up into two. Inspired me to really clean up my own room so the game left me better than it found me!

Unpacking is a short and sweet game that manages to tell a lot with very little. As you unpack items from boxes, you'll get to know their owner's hobbies and habits, the things they gave up on and picked up along the way, the struggles they faced throughout their life.

If you're hoping for hours of play time and significant replay value you're looking at the wrong game. This is a simple idea executed with great attention to detail, meant to be played in one or a few relaxing sessions.

(N.B. while Steam might say I played for 4h at the time of writing, I did watch someone else play through most of the game on stream prior to playing it myself, so that play time is likely on the shorter side. I'd recommend taking your time, as the charm of this game is in the details.)
I liked this game but at some point it got too complicated with too many items and got overwhelming. it is calming until the last few levels. so overall recommend!

Got this game from humble bundle.
Overall the game is pretty fun and creative you don't need to work that hard to make the room but you still need to work on the room to look pretty or speedrun the game lol.

unpacking in my opinion is a extremely relaxing game, its good for calming anxiety and your mood. It comes with fun levels every page/room but in my opinion it wasn't worth the full price as it only has one chapter and is limited and gets boring.

Honestly one of my favorite games ever although I wish there were more levels, like more "stories" for the different photo albums. It's still as calming as it was the first time I played it though. I'm always recommending this game to anyone who will listen.

tldr.text: Very Positive (93%): players love the story and characters.
The main complaint is the price, which some reviewers feel is not worth the money.
